configuration.sampleInterpretation: Observed results from this exact deterministic policy and seed batch only; no V1 calibration or fitted win rate is carried forward.
configuration.seedDesign: independent method-specific seed labels; each of the five methods receives exactly N seeds
configuration.policyContract: uses the current phase, currently reachable nodes, currently visible rewards, public costs, owned artifacts and current equipment; never reads future route nodes, hinted event outcomes, future battle results, or future reward candidates
configuration.policyNotes: Uses the fixed V2 talent plan and fills empty equipment slots, then replaces the weakest same-role slot only for a strictly higher inventory score. Prioritizes reachable rest at 18% missing HP or shop at 20% missing HP when recovery is affordable; otherwise prefers common battles. Does not use reforge or temper.

enemyStatAdjustment.note: Applies only to cloned enemy entity stats in memory; player stats, runtime node values, seed, and YAML files are unchanged.

targets.finalAct: standalone final battle; reported only among runs entering act 5
targets.interpretation: Pass rates are direct observations in this V2 seed batch under the selected deterministic policy; they are not calibrated targets or measured human-player win rates.
